subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Travel history is not only about roads.”?
options: It was also about understanding effort, difficulty, and the people who made the week easier.
It also belonged to people not yet born.
It is also about what happens along the way.
It is also about where people stopped.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It was also about understanding effort, difficulty, and the people who made the week easier.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It also belonged to people not yet born.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It is also about what happens along the way.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Travel history is not only about roads. It is also about where people stopped.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Travel history is not only about roads. It is also about where people stopped.」，答案為「It is also about where people stopped.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It is also about where people stopped.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
